description: This file contains the 'Backup' class within the Opencart Admin Model namespace. It provides methods to perform database backup operations such as retrieving tables, fetching records with pagination, and counting total records in a table.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: A class that provides functionalities to backup database tables within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database tables from the current database, filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Fetches a subset of records from a specified table, ordered by primary key(s), with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in a specified table.
